workload.note: College: 674 rush yds on 113 carries (6.0 YPC), 11 rush TD, plus 2 receiving TD and 2 KR TD. Not an NFL season.

contract.note: Rookie contract signed 2026-05-29 after being drafted No. 32 overall (1st round, 2026 NFL Draft) by Seattle. Exact years/value not disclosed in sources checked.

scheme.note: HC Mike Macdonald: 'We're going to run wide zone and he's going to run wide zone. We're going to run some gap scheme... the pass game he can come alive too... he's a great special teams player.' (seahawks.com, 2026-07-17).

competition.name: Zach Charbonnet
competition.note: Torn ACL 2026-01-17 in NFC divisional playoff win vs SF; surgery 2026-02-20; placed on camp PUP list 2026-07-24; led team with 12 rush TD in 2025; early return estimate ~Oct 2026, but HC Macdonald said (2026-06-30) 'Everything's possible' re: Week 1 and 'If you're betting on anybody, you're going to bet on Zach' to beat typical timeline.

competition.name: Kenneth Walker III
competition.note: Super Bowl LX MVP; departed Seahawks in free agency, signed 3-year deal with Kansas City Chiefs (reported ~2026-03-10).

competition.name: Emanuel Wilson
competition.note: Free-agent signing; per Seahawks reporter Brian Nemhauser (2026-08-08), expected 'two-headed monster of Jadarian Price, Emanuel Wilson early on.'

competition.name: George Holani
competition.note: Returning back; per ESPN's Benjamin Solak (cited 2026-08-08), staff has talked about Holani as 'our third-down back... a timeshare.'

competition.name: Kenny McIntosh
competition.note: Also rehabbing ACL per depth chart notes.
